ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 80-85% low-intensity (black) pixels vs. 15-20% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black) field; large contiguous high-intensity (white/grey) mottled region located on the distal posterior quadrant of the right lobe; isolated high-intensity clusters at both lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 72 degrees; depth extends roughly 15% into the vertical bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration along the continuous trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of variations ranges from 5 to 25 pixels, with deepest jagged peaks on the inner left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex leading edges; trailing edges follow a complex, multi-inflection curve dictated by macro-serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast yellowish-white pixel clusters (epibionts/barnacles) at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of thin, white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (1-4 pixels wide) of varying lengths intersecting the dark pigmentation across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant epibiont colonization on distal tips; extensive white linear rake marks (scars) on ventral surface; multiple irregular trailing edge indentations indicative of physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical pigmentation pattern characterized by a large white mottled patch on the right lobe compared to the near-entirely black left lobe.
